# Ending surface sources

Downloaded 2026-10-15 for the BrainMining ending. Original photographs and texture maps are unmodified; shaders sample, animate, shade and composite them in the game.

| Files | Author / original source | License | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Paper001/*` | Lennart Demes / [ambientCG Paper 001](https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Paper001) | [CC0 1.0](https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/) | Paper fibre, normal and roughness maps, 1K PNG |
| `WaterSplash_ClickerHappy.jpg` | ClickerHappy / [Clear Water Sprinkle, Pexels 67473](https://www.pexels.com/photo/clear-water-sprinkle-67473/) | Asset page explicitly marks **Free to use (CC0)** | Photographic water reflections and broken sheet detail |
| `WaterDroplets_Bicanski.jpg` | Bicanski / [Waterdrop condensation, Pixnio](https://pixnio.com/media/texture-waterdrop-waterdrops-condensation-transparent) | Asset page explicitly marks **CC0 / public domain** | Irregular wet-lens droplets and refraction |
| `Xiaolai-Regular.ttf` | LXGW / [小赖字体 Xiaolai](https://github.com/lxgw/kose-font/releases/tag/v3.126), derived from SetoFont | SIL Open Font License 1.1, full original notice in `Xiaolai-OFL.txt` | Handwritten Chinese title |
| `EndingHandwrittenInk.png` | Typeset locally from the unmodified font above | Rendered typography; font notice retained | Ink-only texture on the final 3D sheet, generated by `Scripts/typeset_ending_title.py` |

Direct downloads:

- https://ambientcg.com/get?file=Paper001_1K-PNG.zip
- https://images.pexels.com/photos/67473/pexels-photo-67473.jpeg?w=1920
- https://pixnio.com/free-images/2021/12/01/2021-12-01-10-15-49-900x1350.jpg
- https://github.com/lxgw/kose-font/releases/download/v3.126/Xiaolai-Regular.ttf
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lxgw/kose-font/master/OFL.txt

Imported game textures live in `/Game/EndingEmergence/Textures`. Only rendered title ink is needed at runtime; the font is retained here as the reproducible source. Water motion is a realtime geometric effect using photographic surface detail, not a fluid simulation or a video clip.
